{{Quote|There is something very touching about them. They look like soldiers; they fight like soldiers; and sometimes they even talk like soldiers. They have all the finest qualities of the fighting man. But behind that is nothing-no love, no family, no happy memory that comes from having truly lived. When I see one of these men killed, I weep more for him than for any ordinary soldier who has lived a full and normal life.|Jedi General Ki-Adi-Mundi|<ref name="Republic Commando: Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
The '''Special Operations Brigade''' ('''SO BDE''') was the special operations division of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], made up of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], [[clone assassin]]s, [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]], and [[Clone shadow trooper/Legends|clone shadow troopers]].

==History==
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] formed the two Special Operations Brigades to complete independent, specialized operations for the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Stationed with [[Arca Company Barracks]], the Special Ops Brigades were led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Iri Camas]] and Jedi General [[Arligan Zey]]. A year into the Clone Wars, the Brigades had taken half casualties, and were merged into one Brigade under General Zey consisting of 5,000 troops.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />
The Special Operations Brigade were part of [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] operations.<ref name="LE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

It was later reorganized as the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]].<ref name="ImpCom501" />

==Command structure==
By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Special Operations Brigade was commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Arligan Zey]]. It consisted of ten Commando Groups, or [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]], by one year after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].

*Special Operations Brigade &mdash;10 [[Commando Group]]s (5,000 troopers plus support personnel), commanded by Jedi General Arligan Zey.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
**Commando Group &mdash;5 [[Company/Legends|companies]] (500 troopers plus support personnel), commanded by a Jedi General.<ref name="TCWCG" />
***Company&mdash;5 [[Troop/Legends|troops]] (100 troopers plus support personnel), commanded by a [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
****Troop&mdash;5 [[Squad/Legends|squads]] (20 troopers ), commanded by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
*****Squad&mdash;4 troopers, including a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Special ops variants==
*[[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commandos]]<ref name="Guide">''[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]'' states that all [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] were part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]].</ref> mostly conducted direct action and special recon missions, in a tactical capacity.
*[[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] served a more strategic purpose, conducting special reconnaissance and special sabotage missions. They were more obedient and reliable to the Jedi than the Null-Class ARCs.
*[[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] specialized in reconnaissance. Less obedient than the Alpha-class ARCs.
*[[Clone shadow trooper/Legends|Shadow troopers]] specialized in gathering intelligence, special sabotage missions, counter intelligence, combating terrorism and [[Clone Intelligence/Legends|espionage]].
*[[Clone assassin]]s were trained specifically to eliminate [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in case of their rebellion against the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] by utilizing [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]], a form of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]].

One notable exception was the [[Covert Ops clone trooper]]s. They were elite clones of the GAR assigned to doing 'dirty work' that most clones would find questionable and unethical for the Republic. The Director of Special Forces ignored the existence of those clones for a long time and they were supposed to take orders from the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="RCTC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
